pages.title: Offense
pages.text: Chain Lightning arcs between nearby enemies, weakening with each jump. Meteor Shower calls down repeated fiery strikes on the same spot over a few seconds, rather than landing all at once. Poison Bolt and Life Drain strike a single target - the latter healing you for a portion of the damage dealt.

pages.title: Support & Control
pages.text: Arcane Shield grants temporary Absorption, and Haste Surge speeds up your movement and mining. Gravity Pull yanks nearby foes toward you, while Shockwave throws them away from you instead.

pages.title: Summon Ally
pages.text: Calls one or more temporary wolves to your side, already loyal and ready to defend you. They fade away on their own once their time is up.

pages.title: Arrow Volley
pages.text: Doesn't fire anything on its own - instead, it enchants your very next shot from a bow, splitting it into a ring of extra arrows the moment it leaves the string. Extra copies add more arrows to the volley, up to a cap.

pages.title: Invisibility
pages.text: Turns you invisible for a short time, letting you slip past danger or line up a shot unseen. Extra copies extend how long it lasts.
